sentences.text: This animal belongs to the subfamily Lambeosaurinae.
It was likely a herbivore that grazed on low-lying plants.
The first dinosaurs found in Kazakhstan were discovered in 1923.
Geologist Vasilij Prynada excavated the fossil horizon near Tashkent from 1924 to 1926.
Anatoly Riabinin formally described the new taxa Jaxartosaurus and Bactrosaurus in 1939.
Anatoly Rozhdestvensky designated a fragment of the skull roof as the lectotype because the original collection contained multiple individuals.
Fossils of this creature have been found in Kazakhstan.
Riabinin classified Jaxartosaurus as a member of Lambeosaurinae based on the skull roof.
Jaxartosaurus lived during the Late Cretaceous, approximately 84 million years ago in the Campanian stage.
The time range for this animal is estimated to be from 89.8 to 83.6 million years ago.
